# cb:b035 · contract-shape-catalogue

> Contract rules decompose into a closed registry of interpretable kinds, each with a Datalog fact shape, an Elixir interpreter module, and required fields per rule entry

**Type:** prescription (contract-grade) · **Kind:** derivation-table · **Domain:** system · **Status:** superseded
**Tags:** `dag-schema`, `dsl`
**Created:** 2026-04-22

## Invariants

- Every contract with non-empty rules must have a kind matching one entry in this catalogue
- Each kind has exactly one interpreter module
- The catalogue is closed: new kinds require updating this contract
